lines: As if it had been settled from the very start
that this is how it would turn out
we're each listening to the other's heartbeat keeping its steady tempo
No matter which words I choose
they somehow feel like lies
The letter I wrote with my left brain—I crumple it into a mess and throw it away
I wonder if the voice of my heart reaches you?
riding on a song of silence.
Darling, darling, I've looked at you from every angle
and every one of them is wonderful, so I come to know love all over again
"Half in doubt—a line of defense so I won't get hurt"—
now, in the subtlest of nuances, you're trying to show me that
"You two make the same face"
someone teased over a photo
I wonder, are we alike?
Or have we grown alike?
To the point where I'd think it was a bother
we faced each other in earnest
So much that the careless person I used to be
now makes me envious
No one will ever hear the voice of my heart
and that's fine—it's better that way
Darling, darling, I know you with all your many faces
Whatever I spend my days doing, I remember you and it hurts
More than all the anniversaries I've written on the calendar
in small, vivid fragments, they fill up my memory
Crying, laughing—unsteady yearnings, but
that is the sign of you and me
Darling, darling, I've looked at you from every angle
Even if a day comes when we can't live together, I know I'll end up loving you anyway
Darling, darling, Oh my darling
maddeningly vivid, it fills up my memory
Darling, darling
